note: Majority: the Family Law (Porodični zakon, Sl. glasnik RS 18/2005 as amended), article 11: majority at eighteen; full capacity also by a court-allowed marriage before majority, or by court leave for a parent of sixteen (not held). Work: the Labour Law (Zakon o radu, Sl. glasnik RS 24/2005 as amended to 109/2025), article 24: employment with a person of at least fifteen; article 25: under eighteen only with a parent's or guardian's written consent and a health finding. The law makes no exception for performers below fifteen, so the form holds them barred (my reading: a child's performing engagement outside employment isn't held). Service: the Law on Military, Labour and Material Obligation (Zakon o vojnoj, radnoj i materijalnoj obavezi, Sl. glasnik RS 88/2009, 95/2010, 36/2018) still sets a six-month term from the year a man turns 19 (articles 24 and 25), but the consolidated text, whose 2010 amendment (95/2010) applies from 1 January 2011, speaks of voluntary service 'after the suspension of compulsory service' (posle obustave obaveze služenja vojnog roka; which article enacted the suspension wasn't found in this text); women aren't conscripted. Service is none. Registration (regrutna obaveza) from the year of 18 and reserve duty to 60 aren't held. Press found by a search on 2026-10-31 (not read) reports a planned 75-day service for men, not yet law as of mid-2026; it isn't modelled. Texts read from Paragraf.rs, a private legal publisher's consolidated texts. Read again 2026-11-03: article 24 says the same in the Labour Ministry's own copy of the consolidated text to 109/2025 (minrzs.gov.rs, taken from the official Legal Information System); the Family Law and the service law still rest on Paragraf.

sources.title: Закон о раду (Sl. glasnik RS 24/2005 ... 109/2025), consolidated editorial text, published by the Ministry of Labour, Employment, Veteran and Social Affairs (minrzs.gov.rs, Документи – Закони – Сектор за рад и запошљавање); the file is marked 'Преузето са https://pravno-informacioni-sistem.rs'
sources.said: Члан 24. Радни однос може да се заснује са лицем које има најмање 15 година живота и испуњава друге услове за рад на одређеним пословима, утврђене законом, односно правилником о организацији и систематизацији послова ... Радни однос са лицем млађим од 18 година живота може да се заснује уз писмену сагласност родитеља, усвојиоца или стараоца, ако такав рад не угрожава његово здравље, морал и образовање, односно ако такав рад није забрањен законом.
